groups.name: spring.actor
groups.description: Pekko pass-through block. Every key under spring.actor.* (for example spring.actor.pekko.loglevel or spring.actor.pekko.cluster.seed-nodes) is passed unchanged to the Pekko actor system configuration, with the spring.actor prefix removed. Comma-separated values are turned into lists. See the Pekko reference configuration for the available keys.

properties.name: spring.actor.pekko.name
properties.description: Name of the Pekko actor system created by the starter. Passed through to Pekko as pekko.name.

properties.name: spring.actor.pekko.actor.provider
properties.description: Pekko actor reference provider, passed through to Pekko as pekko.actor.provider. Set to 'cluster' to run the actor system in cluster mode.

properties.name: management.health.actor.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the actor system and actor cluster health indicators. Setting it to false removes both indicators, also from the readiness group.

values.description: Clustered actor system; enables cluster sharding, singletons and Pekko Management.
